Class CashierGUI

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
CashierGUI
public class CashierGUI extends javafx.application.Application
Author:
Ashwin, Nihal, Oskar, Ruben Cashier view for the boba shop POS. Allows cashiers to browse the menu, select items to build orders, insert orders into PostgreSQL, and view live database updates., Nihal Arumalla, Ruben Hernandez, Ashwin Sathaye, Oskar Zhang
